messages:
maria_support: FYI — ACME (acct ACME-19) escalated: they were billed twice for the annual renewal. Ticket: https://redwood.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/2751. Invoices: INV-2026-0023 and INV-2026-0024. Customer says one payment was via PO #PO-9842 and the other hit their card.
aj_finance: Can you paste the payment processor IDs & timestamps from the ticket? I'll check ledger and Rails admin.
maria_support: From the payment notes in the ticket: card_charge id ch_3N7aXqpm, captured 2026-03-15T14:05:18Z. PO auto-marked-paid triggered payment id py_4M9zKf9, recorded 2026-03-15T14:03:52Z. Both for $48,000 (annual). They emailed AP evidence for PO.
tyler_engineer: @aj_finance :eyes: quick glance in logs — looks like two events processed: one from the PO webhook (internal) that marked invoice paid, then a subsequent card capture came in. Our dedupe for invoice-payment events didn't catch it because the PO flow creates a separate payment record instead of reusing the existing invoice payment id.
kavita_billing: We need to issue a credit note and refund the card. Suggested steps: 1) create credit note CN-2026-58 referencing INV-2026-0024 (duplicate), 2) initiate refund to ch_3N7aXqpm via Stripe, 3) update ledger and post memos for AP to record PO as applied to original invoice. ETA to customer: refund shows in ~2 business days in Stripe, bank posting 5-10 business days.
maria_support: @kavita_billing please confirm when refund is created so I can update the ticket and pass to the customer. They specifically asked for a reversal receipt for their AP team.
aj_finance: Running the admin steps now. SQL small check I ran: ```SELECT id, payment_processor_id, amount, created_at FROM payments WHERE customer_id='ACME-19' AND created_at > '2026-03-15' ORDER BY created_at;``` returned both rows (py_4M9zKf9, ch_3N7aXqpm). I'll create the credit note and kick off refund in Stripe sandbox -> prod.
stripe-bot: Event: payment_refund.created | refund_id: r_1AbcXyZ | charge: ch_3N7aXqpm | status: pending
kavita_billing: Done — credit note CN-2026-58 created and linked to INV-2026-0024. Refund initiated in Stripe (r_1AbcXyZ). Ledger updated: debit AR, credit cash; memo added: "duplicate invoice reversal per support ticket 2751". I also attached the reversal receipt to the Zendesk ticket.
maria_support: I'll confirm with the customer and send the attached reversal receipt. Do we want to proactively notify finance contacts at ACME about the PO application so they can reconcile?
aj_finance: Yes, mention that PO #PO-9842 was applied to INV-2026-0023 and INV-2026-0024 was reversed via CN-2026-58. I put internal note: refund_id r_1AbcXyZ, refund_status pending.
tyler_engineer: Follow-up engineering note — created bug IN-824 for invoice-payment dedupe: root cause is race between manual PO-mark and payment capture webhook. Patch to reuse invoice.payment_intent where available; rolling deploy starting in ~30m, will run a replay test against a staging dump to avoid regressions.
maria_support: Thanks all. I'll update the ticket: refund initiated (Stripe r_1AbcXyZ), credit note CN-2026-58 created, AP/PO applied to INV-2026-0023. Customer told to expect bank posting 5-10 business days. Closing after customer ACKs.
aj_finance: Marking internal case closed once refund moves to succeeded in Stripe.
kavita_billing: +1 :white_check_mark: added comment with accounting reference and exported CSV for ACME AP.
maria_support: Customer replied: "Thanks — refund receipt looks good. AP will reconcile next week." Closing ticket after final bank confirmation. :thumbsup:
